found: code-review (high) over main...HEAD reported 10 findings, all confirmed: (1) RangeSlider/SteppedSlider rebuilt PanResponder each render, so after onChange re-rendered the parent, g.dx was only the latest delta (thumb stutter/snap-back); (2) swipe undo of a 'save' removed items saved before the swipe, with the side effect inside a setState updater; (3) map 'Lagret' mode was built from the filtered list, hiding saved full/filtered items; (4) root layout ignored the useFonts error (blank-forever screen); (5) joinLabel offered 'Bli med' on full experiences while the map offered the waitlist; (6) HONESTY: map experience 'Bli med' had no guest gate and showed 'Du er med — gruppechatten er åpnet.', and Rapporter flipped to a fake 'Rapportert' (Del was a silent no-op); (7) after picking a manual area the locate button only recentered on that area; (8) GPS watchers resolved after stop()/unmount leaked and overrode the chosen area; (9) AddWizard kept a stale 'when' after switching kind; (10) swipe detail Save and Bli med did nothing for signed-in users.
fix: (1) responders created once via useRef, reading latest props through a ref. (2) useSwipeDeck records whether the swipe added the save; undo removes only that, outside the updater. (3) saved mode uses all places + non-cancelled experiences filtered by savedIds. (4) render the Stack on loaded || error. (5) full -> 'Meld på venteliste'; explicit status 'full' counts as full; map detail uses the same wording. (6) ExperienceContent join/waitlist are guest-gated (SignInPrompt) and show DemoNote copy ('Du er med i demoen — ingen reell påmelding, og ingen gruppechat er åpnet.'); DetailActions Del/Rapporter reveal a DemoNote and Rapporter never shows a reported state. (7) locate re-requests GPS when status is granted but a manual area replaced the fix. (8) generation counter: late watch subscriptions are removed and late callbacks ignored. (9) switching kind clears 'when'. (10) Save toggles the shared Saved store with a filled icon; join flips a local demo state labelled 'Du er med · demo'.
not_done: No new tests for the slider gesture, location watcher or swipe-detail buttons (gesture/native paths; verified on device or by reasoning). The availability test previously asserted the buggy 'Bli med' for a full experience; that assertion was corrected (spec now matches the map detail), not weakened.
honesty: Strengthened: no map detail action shows a backend-style success; guests are gated consistently on map and swipe.
verification: typecheck clean; lint clean; 109/109 tests (+3: swipe undo keeps pre-saved item, Lagret ignores filters/status, explicit full status) — the undo and Lagret tests fail with the fixes reverted. found: Fresh-eyes review H2: status-bar icons were near-invisible almost everywhere (white icons on light screens, dark icons on the night map). Cause: expo-status-bar's <StatusBar> applies its style on mount, and tab/stack screens stay mounted, so the swipe tab's or welcome's 'light' outlived them; ThemeRoot's own <StatusBar> never re-applied. Confirmed on the emulator before the fix (white clock on Betaling). H1: stack headers sometimes drawn under the status bar. Reproduced once on the emulator: right after a system dark-mode switch, a freshly deep-linked Innstillinger painted its header with a 0 top inset; three follow-up attempts (fresh screens, mounted screens, same sequence) laid out correctly. Reading: native SafeAreaView measures after mount, so on a busy device a pushed screen can paint before its inset arrives.
fix: src/components/ui/StatusBarStyle.tsx: focus-aware request stack (useFocusEffect push/pop, newest wins, theme fallback set by ThemeRoot via setStatusBarFallback). Light on welcome/splash/swipe/swipe detail/place deck photo; 'auto' for the light filter panel and empty place deck over the swipe tab; map goes light only while the native basemap is in its dusk/night style (periodForKey + exported canUseMapbox). SafeAreaProvider seeded with initialWindowMetrics; Screen and the Add chooser pad from useSafeAreaInsets() instead of a native SafeAreaView. Guard rule: no expo-status-bar import outside StatusBarStyle. CLAUDE.md + DESIGN_SYSTEM.md document both.
not_done: H1 could not be reproduced on demand after the fix landed; the root-cause reading (late native inset measurement) fits the evidence but is not proven. Modal windows (Sheet/Overlay) keep Android's own status-bar handling.
honesty: No product behaviour changed.

fix: .github/workflows/ci.yml, step 'Assert no secret (sk.*) token in exported bundles': `LC_ALL=C grep -rlaE` reads every exported file in dist-web and dist-android as text, byte by byte. Pattern 1 is the old anchored sk.* rule, so back-icon-mask.<hash> stays allowed. Pattern 2 is the Mapbox token body sk.eyJ... without the anchor, because Hermes stores its strings back to back and the byte before a token can be a letter. The step fails when dist-android holds no .hbc and when grep exits other than 0 or 1; -l prints file names only, never the match. The CLAUDE.md CI line now says so.

The local gate scripts in the session scratchpad still use the old grep; they are not in the repo.
